paper.authors_full: Nety Wu, Hyunjin Kim, Chengyi Lin
paper.title: More Ideas, Less Strategic Focus: How AI Changes the Alternatives Decision-Makers Consider
paper.pdf_filename: Wu Kim Lin (2025) - More Ideas, Less Strategic Focus.pdf
paper.version_read: INSEAD Working Paper 2026/17/STR, dated 22 February 2026; revised version of 2025/42/STR, as printed on PDF p. 1.
paper.one_line_finding: Among 305 analyzed MBA students, GPT-4 raised option counts by 1.55 (SE 0.43) with full access and 2.68 (SE 0.55) with ideation-onward access, while full access lowered the strategic share by 0.07 (SE 0.03) and strategic selection by 0.15 (SE 0.07), with no clear partial-access effect on either strategic outcome (PDF p. 38, Table 2).
